name: low-memory-checks
goal: Keep Harness checks within the combined 10 GB target by running one test worker per command and proving that bound from root and workspace entrypoints.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Four orphan Vitest workers from the interrupted four-worker root suite retained 18.8 GB of macOS physical footprint. They were stopped after PID, parent and checkout ownership checks. Harness-owned processes now total about 3.9 GB; the budget is Harness plus its agents and checks, not the entire Mac.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing workspace-test-config guard checks root and inherited collection/setup, but only has one test file per entrypoint and never observes pool size. Extend that shared fixture to several test files and record actual worker PIDs for root, inherited and explicit workspace configs. No Electron tests are needed for this configuration guard.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: Existing workspace-test-config guard now runs three files per entrypoint, recording start/end worker events. On unchanged configs all five root/inherited/explicit cases fail: three concurrent workers observed instead of one; all fixture tests themselves pass. Log /tmp/harness-low-memory-config-red-20261017.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Root exports a shared one-worker Vitest profile; collaboration, remote, relay, hub and reports reuse it. Planning inherits root; desktop already serializes files. AGENTS.md records the combined memory target and one broad operation at a time.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same standardized guard and shared fixture pass all five entrypoints with one concurrent worker; all three test files per entrypoint still pass. Log /tmp/harness-low-memory-config-green-20261017.log. No Electron app was started or tested.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Scoped checks passed: root 845 tests and all six affected non-Electron workspace entrypoints (50 planning, 43 collaboration, 135 remote, 159 relay, 559 reports, 460 hub); format, typecheck, lint, audit and units check pass. One-second macOS footprint samples charge the entire shared Codex CLI backend: peak 5.911 GB, after preview cleanup peak 4.643 GB, final 3.584 GB. Shared desktop UI is excluded. Four abandoned test workers and 12 approved old previews were stopped; the other owner retired an abandoned host fixture. Port 5673 remains listening. No Electron app tests, builds or launches; the full Electron-inclusive repository acceptance remains deferred by user instruction. This is observed usage, not a hard OS memory limit.
